answer: Standing is a wharf that only lets in ships whose flags are hidden: each epoch’s work must be judged blind — peers verify it without knowing who wrote it — and a tide only rises when it is pulled by hands that cannot see the ship, while a wander only counts when the wanderer is unknown. A farm of a thousand fakes cannot hide its flags: its members know each other’s work, so they always vouch for their own — and one epoch of work judged with eyes open adds nothing.
